title: All Hell Breaks Lose When Father Loses His Temper
description:
On November 5th, 2022. Police responded to a hostile scene involving two parents, who had been in a heated argument about the custody of their child. The man said he wanted to see his child but the mother would not let him & and as she was about to pull out of the driveway the man threw a bicycle at the windshield which shattered on the inside leaving glass shards exposed to the woman & the child (who was in the front seat).

Disclaimer: 

The videos on Police Watch are intended solely for informative and educational purposes. They are not meant to encourage or promote any illegal activities or unsafe behavior.  Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus. The content is designed to provide insight into law enforcement procedures, police interactions, and public safety awareness. Always respect the law and follow local regulations.
